description: LENDER-side 'is my offer competitive' check — input your OWN published rate for a state+product, get the market percentile, bps vs the state median, and a leading/competitive/overpriced verdict. This is for a loan officer or credit union benchmarking their published pricing against the live market distribution. Do NOT use this for a consumer's quote: if the user is a BORROWER asking whether a rate they were offered is fair, use rate_sanity_check instead.

apr.description: The lender's published APR. Optional — falls back to rate.

product.description: Mortgage product the lender publishes. Required.

rate.description: The lender's OWN published note rate as a percentage (e.g. 6.49). Required.

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g. CA, TX). Required.

name: check_competitive_position

bps_vs_median.description: Distance from the market median in basis points (-4 = 4 basis points below, i.e. better than median).

market.description: Distribution of live offers this position was measured against.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the newest rate in the market comparison set.

count.description: Number of live published offers the min/median/max were computed from. Small counts make the median unreliable.

max.description: Highest APR, in percent, among the live offers in this segment.

median.description: Median APR, in percent, across the live offers in this segment; the fairest single number to describe 'the market'.

min.description: Lowest APR, in percent, among the live offers in this market segment — the single best published deal, not a typical one.

note.description: Ready-to-quote sentence stating how this offer ranks against live offers and by how many basis points.

percentile.description: Where this offer sits in the market distribution, 0-100, lower being cheaper. 43 means about 43% of live offers are cheaper than it.

product.description: Product key the offer was compared against, e.g. '30yr_fixed'.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

verdict.description: Qualitative placement of the offer against the market, e.g. 'competitive', 'above_market', 'market_leading'.

your_offer.description: The rate and APR the caller supplied for comparison.

apr.description: The supplied APR in percent, including fees; this is what the percentile is computed on.

rate.description: The supplied note rate in percent, excluding fees.
